summary: Add text length validation with configurable max length (1000 chars)

implementation_details.approach: Add MAX_TEXT_LENGTH constant (1000 chars) and _validate_text_length() helper function. Validate in __post_init__(), rename(), and from_dict() automatically via __post_init__.
key_changes: Validation in __post_init__() for constructor and from_dict()

tests.coverage: Tests cover: max length acceptance, over-limit rejection, rename validation, from_dict validation, empty text handling, whitespace handling

risks: Existing code that creates todos with very long text will now raise ValueError
This is a breaking change for clients that relied on unbounded text length
